name: Isoliner3D
description: The Isoliner3D scene and tools for RustGIS. A scene package written by the Isoliner3D window in QGIS opens in its own window with the same camera. Tools 2.11, 2.12, 2.14, 2.17, 2.18, 2.23 and 2.24 compute as in the QGIS plugin.
author: Inform++ LLC

commands.label:
Isoliner3D
Scene
commands.help: Open an Isoliner3D scene package (.i3dscene) in the scene window with its camera, parts and fly-through views.
commands.params: {"path": path to the .i3dscene file; answers the scene name and the number of parts}

commands.label:
Isoliner3D
Tools
commands.help: List the Isoliner3D tools available here with their fields in the RustGIS language.
commands.params: {} (answers the tools with their fields: key, kind, label, hint, default, options, limits)

commands.label:
Run
Tool
commands.help: Run an Isoliner3D tool on the given values and answer its outputs and report.
commands.params: {"tool": the tool's name from the tools command, "values": {field key: value}; a lines field is [{"id", "parts": [[[x, y, z], ...]], "attrs"}], a body field is {"verts": [[x, y, z]], "faces": [[a, b, c]]}; answers the outputs with bodies and fields and the report lines}

ru.The Isoliner3D scene and tools for RustG: Сцена и инструменты Isoliner3D для RustGIS. Пакет сцены, записанный окном Isoliner3D в QGIS, открывается в своём окне с той же камерой. Инструменты 2.11, 2.12, 2.14, 2.17, 2.18, 2.23 и 2.24 считают так же, как модуль QGIS.
ru.Open an Isoliner3D scene package (.i3dsc: Открыть пакет сцены Isoliner3D (.i3dscene) в окне сцены с его камерой, частями и видами облёта.
ru.List the Isoliner3D tools available here: Список инструментов Isoliner3D с полями на языке RustGIS.
ru.Run an Isoliner3D tool on the given valu: Расчёт инструмента Isoliner3D по заданным значениям: выходы и отчёт.
